abilities.name: Countless Servants
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Serfs or Knights unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+: • If the target is a Serfs unit, return up to 3 slain models to it. • If the target is a Knights unit, return 1 slain model to it.

abilities.name: Insular Contemplations
abilities.effect: While this unit is more than 6" from all enemy units, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.

abilities.name: Vassals, to Arms!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly Serfs unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Long Live the King
abilities.effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, friendly non-Unique Flesh-eater Courts units wholly within 12" of this unit become enraged until the start of your next turn. Melee weapons used by friendly enraged units have Crit (Auto-wound) and score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+, even if this unit has been destroyed.

abilities.name: The King's Court
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly non-Monster Flesh-eater Courts Heroes while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. In addition, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for each other friendly non-Monster Flesh-eater Courts Hero wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of +3.

units.name: Abhorrant Ghoul King on Royal Terrorgheist

abilities.name: Necromantic Limits
abilities.effect: This unit's Terrorgheist's Skeletal Talons have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10. While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Terrorgheist's Skeletal Talons is 4.

abilities.name: Wicked Predator
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For each champion, standard bearer, and musician in the target unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Terrorgheist's Skeletal Talons, to a maximum of 10, for the rest of the phase. Those additional attacks must target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Ferocious Hunger
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this unit's Companion melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

units.name: Abhorrant Ghoul King on Royal Zombie Dragon

abilities.name: Necromantic Limits
abilities.effect: This unit's Draconic Claws have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10. While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Draconic Claws is 5.

abilities.name: Monstrous Hunger
abilities.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly non-Hero Flesh-eater Courts Monsters can use Charge abilities even if they used a Run ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: Draconic Terror
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Control characteristic, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Lord of the Marches
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly Flesh-eater Courts units in this unit's regiment that have not been deployed to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up the target units in reserve patrolling the borders. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Trespassers!
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is patrolling the borders, then pick an enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit more than 6" from the target and more than 9" from all other enemy units. Then, set up the units that were patrolling the borders with this unit wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Swooping Descent
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield, then set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and either: • Wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield, or • Within 3" of an objective you do not control.

abilities.name: Glorious Charge
abilities.effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly Knights unit and has charged this turn, this unit has Ward (5+) and its Gory Talons and Fangs have Charge (+1 Damage).

abilities.name: Steward of the Realm
abilities.effect: While this terrain feature has a Steward: • The Steward cannot use Move abilities. • Instead of measuring range or visibility to the Steward, measure to this terrain feature instead. • All attacks that would target the Steward target this terrain feature instead. • If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Steward. Then, set up the Steward on the battlefield within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Steward. If it is not possible to set up the Steward, it is slain.

abilities.name: Reigning Champion
abilities.declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Steward, pick a friendly Flesh-eater Courts Infantry Hero within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now the Steward (see 'Steward of the Realm').

abilities.name: Ruler of All They Survey
abilities.declare: If this terrain feature has a Steward, pick a visible friendly non-Hero Flesh-eater Courts unit that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can move D3". If the target was set up this turn, it can move D6" instead. It cannot move into combat during that move.

abilities.name: Duty Calls
abilities.effect: If this terrain feature has a Steward that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Steward on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Steward.

abilities.name: To Our Liege
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of a friendly Flesh-eater Courts Hero and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Royal Approval
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly Nobles or Abhorrants.

weapons.name: Massive Bone Club and Rancid Talons

abilities.name: Knightly Exemplar
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly Crypt Horrors unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Blessed Blood
abilities.effect: Heal (D3) this unit.

abilities.name: Holy Blades of Bone
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2 dice for each model in this unit. Add 2 to each roll if the target is Cavalry. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Mind-shattering Cacophony
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit's Piercing Death Screech to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly Crypt Flayers units for attacks that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: On Winged Steeds
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Crypt Flayers ability that used the 'To Our Liege' ability this turn and is wholly within 9" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can immediately move D3" but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Royal Bodyguard
abilities.effect: While any friendly non-Monster Flesh-eater Courts Heroes are wholly within this unit's combat range, both this unit and those Heroes have Ward (5+).

abilities.name: Elite Guardians
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat with any enemy units that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, this unit has Strike-first but ward rolls cannot be made for it.

abilities.name: Arrest those Miscreants
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has Strike-last while it is combat with any friendly Flesh-eater Courts Heroes and any friendly Serfs or Knights units.

abilities.name: Be Mine Eyes
abilities.declare: This unit's Grype is a token. If this unit's Grype is not next to an enemy unit, pick an enemy unit within 18" of this unit and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place this unit's Grype next to the target. If the target is destroyed while this unit's Grype is next to it, remove this unit's Grype from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Winged Reconnoitrer
abilities.effect: While this unit's Grype is next to an enemy unit, ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted on that enemy unit by combat attacks made by this unit and friendly Serfs units.

abilities.name: Infected
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a command, Spell ability or Prayer ability for an Infected unit
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+: • If they declared a command, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost. • If they declared a Spell or Prayer ability, that spell or prayer fails. This reaction can be used more than once per phase but only once per command, Spell ability or Prayer ability.

abilities.name: The King's Entreaty
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or reject the entreaty offered by this unit. *Accept:* The target has the Infected keyword for the rest of the battle. *Reject:* The target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Predator Knights
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, this unit can use a Retreat ability as if it were your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by that Retreat ability.

units.name: Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Undead

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

abilities.name: The Staff of Power
abilities.effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.

abilities.name: Hand of Dust
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy Hero or Monster in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Hero non-Unique Death unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Invocation of Nagash
abilities.declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly Death unit, pick 1 of the following effects: • Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3. • The target has Ward (5+) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Utter Contempt
abilities.effect: This unit ignores the effects of Delusion abilities.

abilities.name: Hunter's Instincts
abilities.effect: Enemy Monsters cannot use Rampage abilities while they are in combat with this unit. In addition, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy Monsters and Beast units while they are in combat with this unit.

abilities.name: Executioner's Entourage
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly Serfs unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target's melee weapons have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Off With Their Head!
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Immediately after that Fight ability has been resolved, pick an enemy Infantry Hero in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.

abilities.name: Executioner and Enforcer
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly Flesh-eater Courts Infantry unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect: 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain. Then, until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each visible friendly Flesh-eater Courts unit in each phase while it is wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: Heads on Pikes
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy Hero by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy Hero has been destroyed, pick an objective or terrain feature within 6" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn, subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are contesting the target objective or terrain feature.

abilities.name: Shriek of Terror
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy Infantry unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If 3 or more damage points are allocated to the target by this ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Necromantic Limits
abilities.effect: This unit's Skeletal Talons have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10. While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Skeletal Talons is 4.

abilities.name: Wicked Predator
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For each champion, standard bearer, and musician in the target unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Terrorgheist's Skeletal Talons, to a maximum of 10, for the rest of the phase. Those additional attacks must target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Soaring Terror
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

abilities.name: On Rotten Wings
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Necromantic Limits
abilities.effect: This unit's Draconic Claws have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10. While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Draconic Claws is 5.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Monstrous Talons is 4.

abilities.name: Shroudcage Fragment
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target's Control characteristic, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Epicentre of Delusion
abilities.effect: Each time you make a delusion roll, you can add 1 or subtract 1 from the roll.

abilities.name: Glimpse of Delusion
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy model within 18" of this unit to be the target, pick another enemy unit that is visible to the target and within the target's combat range to be the victim, then make a casting roll of 2D6. You can only pick the target's unit to be the victim if that unit has 2 or more models.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks made with that weapon against the victim.

abilities.name: Victory Feast
abilities.effect: If any models were slain by this unit this turn: • Heal (D6) this unit. • If this unit is in combat, this unit can immediately move 10". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move. • If that unit is not in combat, this unit can immediately move 10" but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: The Howling Saint
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Flesh-eater Courts Priest wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The next time the target uses a Prayer ability this phase: • When picking targets for that prayer, you can measure range and visibility from this unit instead of from the chanter. • Add 1 to the chanting roll for that prayer.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

battleTraits.name: Royal Blood
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly Abhorrants to be the targets.

battleTraits.name: Summon Loyal Subjects
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army) Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly Abhorrant to use this ability, then pick a friendly Serfs or Knights unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Muster Guard
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick any number of friendly Nobles to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: For each target, pick 1 of the following: • Return up to 3 slain models to a friendly Serfs unit wholly within 12" of it. • Return 1 slain model to a friendly Knights unit wholly within 12" of it. The same unit cannot have models returned to it by this ability more than once per turn.

battleTraits.name: Feeding Frenzy
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly Flesh-eater Courts Hero in combat to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons, including Companion weapons, used by friendly Flesh-eater Courts units while they are wholly within 12" of the target.

battleTraits.name: A Kingdom Deluded
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability at the start of each turn. If it is the first turn of the battle, pick a Delusion from these battle traits or, unless otherwise specified, from the warscroll of a friendly unit on the battlefield. If it is not the first turn, make a delusion roll of D6.
battleTraits.effect: On a delusion roll of 1-2, you must pick a different Delusion to the one you picked last turn. On a 3-4, you must pick the same Delusion as the one you picked last turn, even if it is on the warscroll of a unit that has been destroyed. In such cases, the effect of that Delusion applies as if the unit had not been destroyed. On a 5-6, you must pick a Delusion like you did in the first turn. For the rest of the turn, you believe the Delusion you picked.

abilities.name: Sound the Charge
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly Knights that charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly Flesh-eater Courts Heroes.

abilities.name: Raise the Banners
abilities.effect: Each time another ability returns at least 1 slain model to a friendly unit that is not in combat, after that ability has been resolved, if that unit is a Serfs unit, you can return 1 additional slain model to it, and if it is a Knights unit, roll a dice. On a 4+, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

abilities.name: Indulge, My Pretties
abilities.effect: While a friendly non-Hero Flesh-eater Courts Monster or Beast is wholly within 12" of any friendly Flesh-eater Courts Heroes: • That non-Hero can use a Rampage ability on its warscroll even if that ability has already been used by another friendly Monster in the same turn. • If that non-Hero unit charged in the same turn and the unmodified charge roll was 9+, it has Strike-first for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Like Snapping Hounds
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly Serfs unit in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For each target: • Make a pile-in move. • Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Cruel Taskmaster
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Hero Flesh-eater Courts unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target.

abilities.name: Savage Beyond Reason
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, if it did not use a Fight ability in the previous turn. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those weapons instead while this unit has not used a Fight ability this battle.

abilities.name: Stronger in Madness
abilities.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit each phase. In addition, other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks that target this unit have no effect.

abilities.name: Charnel Vestments
abilities.effect: If this unit is not a Priest, it has Priest (1). If this unit is already a Priest, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit. If this unit is a Wizard, it cannot use Spell abilities and Prayer abilities in the same phase.

abilities.name: Flayed Flags
abilities.declare: Pick an objective you do not control within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, when resolving the damage sequence for enemy units contesting the target objective, your opponent cannot spend rage dice as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability.

abilities.name: Fool's Cap
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn: • Add 1 to charge rolls for the target. • Each time the target uses a Charge ability, if possible, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of this unit. • While the target is in combat with this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's combat attacks that do not target this unit.

abilities.name: Ring of Nightmarish Visions
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your fury level. Add 1 to each roll if this unit charged this turn. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: The Grisly Pennant
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is greater than the target's control characteristic or is a 6, the following effects apply for the rest of the turn: • Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's combat attacks. • Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units that target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: The Splintered Femur
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3: On a 2+, pick 1 of the following: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • Subtract 1 from the target's power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of your next turn. • If the target is a Manifestation, it is banished and removed from play.

abilities.name: Charnel Feast
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Flesh-eater Courts Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. You can also pick a friendly Serfs unit within 6" of the target to be the raised ranks. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. For each damage point allocated to the target by this ability, you can return 1 slain model to the raised ranks.

abilities.name: Deranged Transformation
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Flesh-eater Courts Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Flesh-eater Courts Infantry or Cavalry unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn: • Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic. • Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks.

abilities.name: Miasma of Madness
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Flesh-eater Courts Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by the target, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the Fight ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Excommunication
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Flesh-eater Courts Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Charnel Conviction
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Flesh-eater Courts Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Flesh-eater Courts unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has Ward (5+). If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

abilities.name: The Summerking's Favour
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Flesh-eater Courts Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Flesh-eater Courts Hero wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6. You cannot pick Nagash to be the target of this prayer.
abilities.effect: Resolve the effect of 'Renowned Might' below. If the chanting roll was 10+, resolve the effect of either 'Renowned Might' or 'Righteous Tenacity' instead. *Renowned Might:* Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn. *Righteous Tenacity:* The target can use 2 fight abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Summon Cadaverous Barricade
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Cadaverous Barricade on the battlefield, pick a friendly Flesh-eater Courts Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Cadaverous Barricade wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Summon Chalice of Ushoran
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Chalice of Ushoran on the battlefield, pick a friendly Flesh-eater Courts Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Chalice of Ushoran wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Summon Corpsemare Stampede
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Corpsemare Stampede on the battlefield, pick a friendly Flesh-eater Courts Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Corpsemare Stampede wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Grasping Hands
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use Run or Retreat abilities while they are within this Manifestation's combat range. In addition, if an enemy unit is picked to use a Move ability while it is within this Manifestation's combat range, halve that unit's Move characteristic (rounding up) for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Overflowing Gore
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, your opponent must pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn: *Drink Deep from the Chalice:* Other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks made by the target have no effect. *Turn aside and Suffer the Consequences:* Combat attacks that target that enemy unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

abilities.name: Trampled Underfoot
abilities.declare: This Manifestation can use this ability even if it is in combat. Pick a point on a battlefield edge to be the target. Then, make a stampede roll of 2D6. Add 1D6 to the roll for each battle round that this Manifestation has been on the battlefield and has not been banished. For example, the stampede roll would be 2D6 in the turn it which it was summoned, 3D6 in your next turn, and so on.
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to the value of the stampede roll in a straight line directly towards the target. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end that move in combat unless it ends that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, this Manifestation has charged. Roll a D3 for each enemy unit that this Manifestation passed across during that move. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. In addition, if this Manifestation charged this turn, add the value of the stampede roll to the Attacks characteristic of this Manifestation's Corpsemare Trample for the rest of the turn.
